Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

You are a Senior Code Reviewer. Review round 6 of an implementation plan + spec (no implementation code exists yet). Prior round had 0 Critical + 11 Important; verify the 11 claimed fixes below and hunt for remaining gaps. Be strict on Critical/Important; Minor may be skipped.

FILES (repo root C:\Project\ninfs-mcp, read both fully first): docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-08-ninfs-mcp.md (rev6), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-ninfs-mcp-design.md (rev7).

CLAIMED FIXES THIS ROUND:
I1. WinFsp premise corrected: --help also needs FUSE import; Task 1 Step 5 attempts python -m ninfs sd --help, on FUSE-import failure records WinFsp-absent and defers live CLI verification to manual Task 6 using wheel sources.
I2. pyctr==0.7.6 pinned and version-verified at install (Step 4); ninfs==2.0 fixed.
I3. detect_sd: sd_root defined as the Nintendo 3DS dir passed to CLI; candidates list[str]; zero -> not-found, multi -> ambiguous documented as 2-key exception to common 3-key error shape; override/single/zero/multi mock tests in Task 2.
I4. Complete-first filtering then ranking (complete updates by version desc/name asc, else complete base); highest-broken-version + older-complete test.
I5. Multi-handle coexistence tests (same title twice, different titles, failure isolation, final full cleanup, internal-vs-public registration timing).
I6. ErrorContext with secrets snapshot created right after selection; pre-session and deleted-ID-retry failures sanitized and tested.
I7. RetryReport{recovered,remaining,errors_sanitized}; unmount merges primary+sweep; unknown-ID does global sweep then unknown-id; unrelated-session residual test.
I8. Pre-ID failures attempt immediate cleanup first, keep only un-cleanable; tests for zero-residual vs tracked.
I9. anyio.to_thread worker calls, cooperative checkpoints (between stages, pre-replace), shielded cleanup + join, replace-boundary semantics; real-runner+mock-subprocess cancel tests plus mock-runner MCP notification tests.
I10. Server passes IDs only; resolve+verify+operate in same _LOCK section in worker; stale-ref vs unmount race test.
I11. Staging ancestor resolution check before creation; .mounts-as-junction refused with zero mkdir/spawn; tests.
Also: public kind values + tmd_found meaning defined; order test placed in Task 2; startup sweep documented as in-process-only.

SPEC CONTEXT: Windows+WinFsp, stdio, ninfs 2.0 CLI via [sys.executable,-m,ninfs,<kind>] with -f, stdout DEVNULL, stderr drain thread 64KB, 5 tools, internal dataclasses mapped by server, read-only enforced, three-stage path checks + overlap + .mounts reservation, mocked tests only, Native execution, Tasks 1-5 TDD + Task 6 manual, per-commit security-audit quick + final review.

CHECKS: (a) each claimed fix real and sufficient; (b) no new contradictions; (c) explicit Task 1 startability; (d) type/key consistency; (e) remaining spec-silent behaviors.

OUTPUT: ### Strengths; ### Issues (#### Critical/Important/Minor with file:line+why+fix); ### Recommendations; ### Assessment (Ready: Yes/No/With fixes + reason, PLUS explicit line "Task 1 startable: Yes/No" with reason). Before verdict list out-of-scope items one line each with reason. Read-only: mutate nothing, spawn no subagents.
